hypothesis_summary: Abstract the GoogleGenAI initialization, prompt generation, error handling (specifically TopologyViolationError propagation), and JSON schema definitions into a single generic Cognitive Executor function. This enforces a stricter boundary (Negative Space Scaffolding) around the AI invocation, reducing cognitive complexity and centralizing the FIPI/Epistemic Escrow logic.
justification_or_plan: 1. Create `services/cognitiveExecutor.ts` to host `executeGenerativeTask<T>`. 2. Move `GoogleGenAI` initialization and the standardized `try/catch` block handling `TopologyViolationError` into this centralized function. 3. Refactor `services/geminiService.ts` to replace repetitive API calls with `executeGenerativeTask<T>`. 4. Refactor `services/pmPersonaService.ts` to utilize the new executor. 5. Run `npx vitest run` to ensure the 'Fix Until Green' autonomic loop is satisfied.
